episodes.instruction: Grab the mug with white logo print on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Grab the beige coffee mug from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the beige coffee mug on the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the smooth ceramic mug from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the smooth ceramic mug on the medium-sized rack.
